children: Holley made a voluntary $10 million prepayment on its first lien term loan, bringing total debt repaid since 2023 to $125 million.
Voluntary $10M prepayment on first lien term loan announced September 23, 2026 — continues balance sheet optimization.
Total debt repayments reach $125M since September 2023, funded entirely through free cash flow generation.
Company reduced total leverage from a 5.67x peak and remains on track for year-end leverage below 3.5x.
Cumulative $125M reductions are expected to generate about $5M in annualized net interest savings.
